annotations.title: Test an A/B result for significance

description: Run a two-proportion z-test on two variants of an ad, landing page or audience, and report the p-value, whether the difference is statistically significant at the chosen confidence level, and how much more traffic would be needed to resolve it if it is not. Use it for any comparison of two rates instead of judging the gap by eye.

variant_a_trials.description: Denominator for variant A: impressions for a click rate, clicks for a conversion rate.

name: ab_test_significance
